prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: distinctive premium symbol for Cage, a TypeScript business framework for AI collaboration.
Primary request: Create a sophisticated iconic emblem built from THREE interlocking architectural ribbons forming an open capital C in isometric perspective. The ribbons create a compact sculptural framework with precise dovetail-like joins and thoughtfully cut negative space. A single lime structural connector integrates into the inner right opening. The whole mark must feel proprietary, memorable and carefully engineered, with layered construction rather than a generic C and square. Convey protected creative space and connected business modules. Complexity is controlled: three main bands, meaningful internal voids, one accent connector.
Style: polished contemporary tech identity with restrained dimensional depth, precise beveled edges, rich dark green facets, subtle sage highlights. Graphically bold with an instantly readable overall C silhouette. This is a finished logo symbol, not a sketch or collection of concepts.
Composition: one centered symbol occupying 72 percent of a square canvas, generous clear margins. Uniform pure white background, absolutely no ground shadow for clean background extraction.
Color palette: dark forest green #163F35, emerald-sage facets, one soft lime #C8E78B connector. Strong contrast, premium finish.
Constraints: no text, no letters printed on surfaces, no wordmark, no watermark, no multiple variants, no outer badge, no padlock, no shield, no stock AI sparkle, no knot resembling the OpenAI logo, no overly delicate wires. Aim for a crafted architectural monogram with visual intelligence and enough substance to sustain a close look.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium wide editorial brand hero for the open-source Cage framework.
Primary request: Build an intricate, art-directed miniature architectural world showing an intelligent business system taking shape inside a sculptural open C-shaped framework. It is a convincing architectural diorama, rich enough to discover details on a second look. Three staggered terraces sit within the forest-green structural frame: a precise drafting table with schema-like engraved rows at the first level; interlocking process machinery, looped rails and approval gates at the second; a compact illuminated network observatory at the third. Small lime data capsules follow carefully organized tracks between levels. Thin brass-like muted green conductors, ribbed surfaces, structural braces, small machined connectors, layered translucent mint panels and precision-cut slots create physical depth. Include sophisticated changes of material: dark anodized green metal, ivory ceramic, frosted mint glass and a few luminous lime elements. The central activity should express constructing, coordinating and understanding business within an intentional framework.
Composition: wide 3:1 landscape with asymmetric editorial balance. Reserve the leftmost 40 percent as quiet warm ivory space for later typography. All detailed world-building is concentrated in the rightmost 55 percent. Full object visible with air around it; three-quarter view, slightly elevated camera, clear foreground/midground/background layers. Some rails and panels extend outside the open right side to suggest extensibility, but remain compositionally connected. Rich controlled detail, not a random pile of cubes.
Lighting: beautiful cinematic soft daylight, subtle ambient occlusion, believable soft shadows, a small amount of rim light and gentle reflected green light. Warm ivory #F5F4EC background; deep forest green #163F35, sage, soft lime #C8E78B. Premium editorial CGI with precise modeling and tactile surfaces, architect's collectible model meets an advanced software workshop.
Constraints: no words, no letters, no numbers, no pseudo-code, no fake application screenshots, no logos, no human characters, no robots, no stock shields, no neon blue or purple, no enormous empty cubes. Do not simplify to a single C frame holding three blocks: the requirement is a richly resolved, cohesive world with interconnected details. Keep the left typography zone quiet and uncluttered.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: richly detailed editorial illustration for Cage README, illustrating one business declaration supporting an entire system.
Primary request: An ambitious architectural cutaway diorama of a coherent business system. At the center, a substantial ivory layered declaration folio with carefully engraved schema rows rises from an open dark-green structural pavilion. From this single source, three organized rail-and-conduit paths connect to three richly realized miniature districts around it. Left district: a precision fabrication atelier of aligned schema plates, mechanical guides and layered contract cards, symbolizing generation. Right district: an operational engine with interlocking mechanisms, approval gates and small orderly data capsules, symbolizing execution. Foreground district: an elegant miniature observatory of faceted nodes, translucent mint panels and precise connecting bridges, symbolizing business understanding and AI context. The districts are distinct but clearly use the same architectural vocabulary, construction grid and material palette. Strong central source, exactly three primary connections, many carefully integrated secondary details within each district.
Style: premium architectural CGI editorial illustration, sophisticated geometry, tactile matte ceramic, anodized forest-green metal, frosted mint glass, narrow lime accent strips. Include construction detail such as inset seams, ribs, stairs, layered platforms, precise machined joints, tiny rail vehicles and structural cross-sections. Detail should reward close inspection and convey a working system without becoming cluttered. Warm diffused daylight, cinematic ambient occlusion, no harsh contrast.
Composition: landscape 2:1 canvas, elevated isometric three-quarter view. Central pavilion slightly back, three districts around it, linked by elegant channels over the warm ivory ground. Balanced masses, varied heights and convincing depth. All elements are fully visible with an 8 percent safe margin. Palette forest green #163F35, ivory #F5F4EC, sage and soft lime #C8E78B.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, pseudo-code, watermarks, real UI screens, test statistics, robots or security shields. Not just four simple stacks of cubes: create a finely crafted miniature system with purposeful connections, material variation and multiple scales of detail. This is conceptual imagery, not a literal technical architecture diagram.
